title: Baum-OS Failure Pattern Card
description: JSON Schema for Baum-OS failure-pattern YAML cards (Self-Harness Evolution Lab surface). Anchors reproducible weakness signatures with evidence refs, severity, confidence, status, and twin safety gates (proposal_allowed / promotion_allowed). Validated against draft 2020-12 meta-schema before promotion.
$comment: v0.1.0 — proposed, opt-in, no runtime. Aligns with skills/harness/weakness-mining.skill.yaml output contract (YAML, draft_only, human_approval_required=true). Does NOT promote Self-Harness Evolution Lab from aspirational to active in the root architecture (docs/architecture/baum-os-harness-family.md §7).

pattern_id.description: Unique failure-pattern identifier. Convention: fp-<slug> where slug is lowercase, dashes allowed. Mirror root doc/evidence naming style.

name.description: Concise human-readable pattern title. One sentence, no trailing punctuation.

severity.description: Operational severity if the pattern triggers. low = cosmetic, medium = workflow friction, high = correctness/audit risk, critical = safety/data-loss boundary.

confidence.description: How well the pattern is anchored. observed = directly reproduced, inferred = reasoned from evidence without live reproduction, consensus = multiple independent observers agree.

evidence_anchors.description: Ordered list of evidence refs (commits, files, runs, chat turns) that anchor this pattern. Minimum one anchor required.

ref.description: Anchor identifier. commit = sha, file = path, run = sandbox/runs/<ts>, chat = room/timestamp, observation = short label, doc = path.

note.description: Optional human note about why this anchor matters.

affected_surfaces.description: Repository paths or surface names the pattern touches. Use exact paths when possible.

trigger_conditions.description: Conditions under which the pattern reproduces. Concrete state, command, or sequence.

observed_symptoms.description: What an observer actually sees when the pattern fires (logs, dirty tree, missing file, wrong status).

root_cause_hypothesis.description: Best-current explanation for why the pattern occurs. Mark inferred if not proven.

recommended_mitigations.description: Mitigation candidates ordered by preference (cheapest, safest first).

owner_action_required.description: True if mitigation cannot run without human owner approval (push, secret rotation, dependency install, etc.).

status.description: Lifecycle status. proposed = draft, accepted = owner-approved for tracking, mitigated = fix verified, rejected = owner-declined, superseded = replaced by a newer pattern_id.

superseded_by.description: pattern_id that replaces this card (filled when status=superseded).

last_reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 date of last owner/curator review. Used to detect stale cards.

proposal_allowed.description: Whether derived tool/skill can auto-propose actions from this card. Default false.

promotion_allowed.description: Whether derived tool/skill can auto-apply changes from this card. Hard gate. Default false.
